Two charged, massive particles are isolated from all influence except those between the particles. They have charge and mass such that the net force between them is 0 N. Which of the following is NOT true?
Option A: The particles must have the same sign of charge.
Option B: If the distance between the particles changes, the force will no longer be 0 N.
Option C: The particles must have the same mass.
Option D: Such a situation is impossible as the net force between the two particles cannot be 0.
